constants.label: Lab reference run (23 attempts)

fig_jury_calibration.what: per-juror AUROC, sensitivity, specificity on 28 candidates; cost of 5 calls

fig_calls_tokens_time.what: distribution per model and role of input/output tokens and latency per call
fig_calls_tokens_time.transform: log10 x-axis; zero values drawn at 1; boxes without outliers, points are calls

fig_cost_per_repair.what: sum of list-price cost of all calls per condition / attempts and / verified repairs

fig_coverage_rule.what: FAR of claims and of claims that touch every hinted range (+-3 lines)

C1 (main): results.csv without hint_coverage (re-run fa_metrics.py of v4 on runs/final)
